But on the last day of the month, a $300 birthday check from your daughter clears, bumping your account to $2,100 as a new month begins. articles.title: Blakeman’s campaign finance mess
articles.dek: MO’ MONEY: Republican gubernatorial candidate Bruce Blakeman has received dozens of contributions surpassing the legal limit in recent months.
